crossRefs.note: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

translations.web: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.
translations.bsb: She also put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.
translations.kjv: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
translations.asv: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck.
